Join us! Position Summary: This job is responsible for maximizing the value for one or more products. Key responsibilities include working with stakeholders to understand their needs, and with product owners or specialists to ensure they are aligning on priorities.

Job expectations include ensuring delivery of products that meet client expectations, including features, security, availability, resiliency, timelines and costs. Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for AWS based products and services (e.g., landing zones, data platforms, developer platforms, cloud-native services).

Translate business and customer needs into AWS service offerings that drive adoption, scalability, and value. Prioritize features and improvements using data-driven insights, stakeholder input, and alignment with enterprise objectives.

You enjoy working with cross-functional teams, defining product vision, prioritizing initiatives, and driving AI adoption across the organization. You are analytical, customer-focused, and comfortable balancing business needs, technical feasibility, and user experience to maximize the impact of AI investments.

Proven experience defining product vision, strategy, roadmaps, and managing product backlogs. Strong understanding of Machine Learning fundamentals. Hands-on experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, and Prompt Engineering.

Partner closely with Engineering, Data, Operations, and Executive Leadership to successfully deliver AI-powered products. Define, monitor, and optimize product KPIs, business outcomes, and value realization metrics.

Ensure Responsible AI, governance, compliance, and best practices are incorporated throughout the product lifecycle. Continuously improve AI products through customer feedback, experimentation, and iterative delivery.

Communicate AI capabilities, risks, limitations, and opportunities to both technical and business audiences. 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager or Product Owner. Mural’s Admin & Security portfolio owns the experiences that let organizations adopt, govern, and measure the value of Mural at enterprise scale. The portfolio spans three domains: Admin & Identity Management, Enterprise Security, & Customer Insights. This role leads Customer Insights and supercharges it into a surface that turns Mural’s product data into the narratives that drive renewals, fund expansion, and prove the ROI of collaboration to Admins and buyers.

Own the Customer Insights product area end-to-end. Build the user facing experiences and the data foundation to turn raw data into shared, clear, and actionable narratives. Define Mural’s POV on what AI-native insights look like as the category shifts from static dashboards to proactive, conversational, agentic interfaces.

s.h: You’ll work across three layers in parallel
s.t:
The canonical usage data layer: This is the foundation that powers Company Insights today and needs to be deliberately built and enriched so other surfaces such as engagement, growth, AI, can consume it tomorrow.
The customer-facing surface: This is how the data is presented in-product, whether it’s on an insights page, a dashboard, scheduled and ad hoc reporting, audit logs, or APIs that can be consumed by Admins, end users, execs, and Mural teams.
The AI-native expansion: How Mural incorporates natural language queries, agentic workflows, and proactive analytics to evolve and extend the insights surface.

Own product strategy, roadmap, and execution for Customer Insights from data model through customer-facing experience
Define the usage data layer in partnership with Engineering and Data including the metrics that anchor renewal and expansion narratives
Evolve customer-accessible audit logs to be enterprise ready
Define Mural's POV on AI-native insights and ship the first set of AI-powered capabilities on this surface
Partner with Sales and Customer Success to translate insights into the narratives that win renewals and unlock expansion
Engage directly with enterprise Admins, IT, and Security stakeholders to validate priorities and stress-test the roadmap
Co-own the seams with Admin & IAM and Enterprise Security PMs so the insights surface composes cleanly with permissions, access controls, and compliance posture
Translate ambiguous business questions into clear product surfaces

4+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 building analytics, reporting, or data products for a business or admin audience
Strong data fluency from shaping data models, instrumentation strategy, and can hold your own with engineers on freshness, granularity, aggregation, and pipeline tradeoffs
AI product sense from using AI tools regularly, and can hold a real point of view on what AI-native data products look like
A track record of turning ambiguous business questions into clear product surfaces
Experience partnering with Sales and Customer Success on renewal and expansion narratives
Excellent communication across data, design, engineering, and revenue-facing stakeholders
Bonus
Experience with enterprise admin or governance products (IAM, security, compliance, audit)
Background in BI, analytics platforms, or data products
Experience designing customer-facing APIs for analytics and reporting

Customer Insights sits at the intersection of three valuable surfaces - and the surface you’ll own directly drives the conversations that grow Mural’s largest accounts. Not only that, but you will also set the strategic ambition for the analytics surface itself - defining where insights extends across Mural as a product over time.

Die dokSAFE GmbH ist ein Leipziger Softwareunternehmen, das sich auf die Entwicklung der SaaS-Lösung Actaport spezialisiert hat. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam daran, mit unserer Kanzleisoftware die Arbeitswelt in der Anwaltskanzlei zu revolutionieren.
Du willst nicht nur Anforderungen verwalten, sondern ein Produkt wirklich gestalten — nah an Kunden, nah an der Rechtspraxis und nah am Entwicklungsteam? Dann suchen wir genau DICH! Als Product Owner (m/w/d) trägst Du die Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung von ACTAPORT von der Anforderungsaufnahme über die Backlog-Priorisierung bis zum Release.

Du übersetzt juristische und gesetzliche Anforderungen in konkretes Produktdesign — und sorgst dafür, dass das, was wir bauen, auch wirklich genutzt wird.
Aufgaben
Du verantwortest die Weiterentwicklung unserer Kanzleisoftware von der Konzeption bis zum Release und behältst dabei Nutzerbedürfnisse, gesetzliche Anforderungen und Produktvision gleichzeitig im Blick.
Du nimmst Anforderungen von Kunden und dem Gesetzgeber auf, analysierst sie und überführst sie in praxis- und benutzerorientierte Funktionen.
Du agierst als enger Sparringspartner für das Entwicklungsteam, um Rückfragen zu klären, Scope zu schärfen, Prioritäten verständlich zu machen und Blocker früh aufzulösen.
Du pflegst und priorisierst das Product Backlog und begleitest den Entwicklungsprozess in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Entwicklungsteam nach agilen Methoden (bspw. Scrum).
Du präsentierst Produktfortschritte gegenüber Stakeholdern, unterstützt bei der Qualitätssicherung und gibst dem Team klares Feedback zu Akzeptanzkriterien.
Du dokumentierst neue Funktionen und schulst bei Bedarf Mitarbeitende und Kund:innen.
Qualifikation
Ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Rechtswissenschaften, Betriebswirtschaftslehre, der IT oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation bildet die Grundlage — entscheidend ist Dein Verständnis für juristische Prozesse und Nutzerbedürfnisse.
Du verfügst über eine Zertifizierung nach CSPO oder PSPO 1.
Du arbeitest strukturiert, detailorientiert und eigenverantwortlich und hast ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für UI/UX.
Du interessierst Dich für digitale Trends, KI und Legal Tech und bringst technische Affinität für Cloud-Software mit.
Deine sehr guten Deutsch- sowie Englischkenntnisse ermöglichen eine reibungslose Kommunikation im Team und mit Stakeholdern, um Ideen effektiv zu teilen und Ziele gemeinsam zu erreichen.

Wir bieten eine sehr gute Work-Life-Balance durch flexible Arbeitszeiten.
Wir leben ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell — Homeoffice ist bei uns selbstverständlich möglich.
Neben 30 Urlaubstagen erhältst Du eine sehr gute Vergütung und zusätzliche finanzielle Benefits (Kitazuschuss, steuerfreier Sachbezug als Deutschlandticket oder 50€-Gutschein).
Wir statten Dich mit modernen Arbeitsgeräten und einer zeitgemäßen Entwicklungsumgebung aus — Du entscheidest, womit Du am liebsten arbeitest.
Dich erwarten flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege.
Dich begrüßen erfahrene Teamplayer in einem motivierten, inklusiven Team. Nach Deiner ausführlichen Einarbeitung arbeitest Du eigenverantwortlich in diesem.
Dich erwarten vielfältige Möglichkeiten für Deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung sowie eine optionale betriebliche Altersvorsorge.
Werde Teil unseres Teams und revolutioniere mit uns die Arbeitswelt in Anwaltskanzleien. Gestalte Deine Zukunft bei dokSAFE GmbH und bewirb Dich jetzt - wir freuen uns auf Dich!

Liberis is in the middle of a meaningful shift. We started as a single-product business and are quickly becoming a truly multi-product embedded finance company, with different funding structures, revenue models and customer relationships sitting alongside each other in the same portfolio. That complexity creates real demand for better data, better insight and clearer thinking about how all of it fits together - with this role sitting at the centre of that challange!

As our Senior Data Product Manager, you’ll sit right at the intersection of product, analytics, engineering and senior leadership, helping define the data products that power smarter decisions across Liberis.

You’ll have real ownership over roadmap, prioritisation and ways of working, and your work will directly influence how teams access, understand and use data day to day. This role is a high-impact opportunity for someone who wants to shape how a business uses data at scale!

You’ll be joining a team with a broad remit and a genuine mandate to improve the data experience across the company, so there’s a lot of scope to make the role your own and shape the future of the domain.

You will own the data and insights product for Liberis, building the foundations that let our commercial, credit and operations teams actually understand the business they're running.

That means, thinking carefully about the entities in our data model, how products and customers relate to each other, how those relationships surface in reporting and analysis - and how it eventually all comes out in great dashboards, tools and self-serve capabilities.

This is about shipping products which are genuinely useful, not just technically correct.

Our Engineering Team is going through an AI-first transformation, rethinking how teams are structured and how they ship. Data, insights and analytics are a crucial part of that journey and you will be a key player in leading, innovating and rapidly improving our posture and capabilities at the intersection of data and AI.

If you like solving genuinely hard problems, bringing clarity to complex environments and building products that have visible business impact - this is the role for you!

Your primary job is to help Liberis's commercial decision makers understand the small businesses we serve and how they consider, use and perform across our product range. Doing this well requires a clear conceptual model of the business and a willingness to engage with stakeholders across the business, as well as taste and customer empathy in developing a great insights product including dashboards, insight tools and self-serve capabilities.

You will own the roadmap for our internal data & insight products. Working with stakeholders across commercial, credit, finance and operations, you will define what good looks like and then work with your team to build it. You will run prioritisation, manage the backlog and make decisions about where effort goes.

You will also spend a meaningful amount of time in the detail, reviewing data models and dashboards, asking hard questions about definitions, and making sure what we ship is accurate and trusted.

You will partner closely with the engineering side of your team on how data is modelled and structured in BigQuery and DBT, and with analysts on how it gets presented in Looker. You don't need to write production code, but you need enough technical understanding to be a genuine partner in those conversations. You will also be responsible for continuing to expand our partner-facing reporting, whereby partners gain visibility into their portfolio.

This role requires someone who can think clearly about complex data structures and translate that thinking into products that non-technical people actually find useful. The ideal person has strong conceptual thinking skills, great product instincts and enough technical depth to earn the trust of the engineers and analysts they work with.

· Proven experience in a senior data product or analytics product role in a business with real complexity

· A track record of helping commercial teams make better decisions through better data, not just shipping dashboards

· Strong ability to think about entities, taxonomies and relationships in data

· Hands-on experience with Looker and LookML and familiarity with best practices and scalable approaches to these systems

· Working knowledge of SQL, DBT and BigQuery, enough to engage seriously with how data is modelled and what's feasible, and to express your thinking in code-speak where needed

· Experience working with a multi skilled team of analysts and data engineers

· Clear, confident communication with senior commercial stakeholders

Next steps If this opportunity feels like the right fit for your next career move, we’d love to hear from you!

Even if you don’t meet every requirement, don’t hesitate to apply or reach out to Chess (Internal Recruiter) on

Our hybrid approach

Working together in person helps us move faster, collaborate better, and build a great Liberis culture. Our hybrid working policy requires team members to be in the office at least 3 days a week, but ideally 4 days. At Liberis, we embrace flexibility as a core part of our culture, while also valuing the importance of the time our teams spend together in the office.

Semarchy has grown into an industry leader in the data management space. We're searching for a Product Manager to help expand the Semarchy Data Platform (SDP) and support our development teams. As a Product Manager, you are one of our core creative talents.

Reporting to the Head of Product Management and working closely with engineering, design, and the field, you will turn customer problems and market evidence into product capabilities that customers value — and pay for. Your goal will be to increase the adoption and market fit of the Semarchy Data Platform.

You will own your product scope end-to-end: discovering what customers actually need, framing the problems worth solving, prioritizing ruthlessly, shaping the roadmap, and partnering across teams to bring capabilities to market successfully.

Your early focus is likely to involve Semarchy 's AI-oriented capabilities — such as agentic access to governed Data Products and AI-assisted stewardship — so experience or genuine enthusiasm in this area is a real advantage.

As with any growing product organization, scope and responsibilities will be shaped together and are expected to evolve over time. We are therefore looking for someone adaptable and curious, who thrives when the problem space is still taking shape. Responsibilities
Discovery & customer research: Run structured problem discovery — investigate problem spaces, validate pain intensity and business impact, map current alternatives, and confirm willingness to change. Engage continuously with customers and partners, including active participation in design partner programs.
Focus on customer value: Anchor every decision in customer outcomes rather than mechanisms. Be able to articulate the customer, the problem, and why it matters — and bring that evidence into product decisions.

Term: Full-time, permanent

Are you passionate about professional studio monitors and the craft of making music?
Do you have a strong track record in hardware product management?
Do you enjoy working in fast-paced, cross-functional teams to bring exciting and technically challenging new product ideas to life?
We are looking for a forward-thinking and experienced Product Manager to own one or more of our active studio monitor lines end-to-end - from customer insight and business case, through requirements definition and stage-gate development, to launch and life in the market.
Reporting to the Head of Product, you will be the cross-functional centre of your line(s) and make trade-offs on features, performance, cost and timing that get exceptional monitors into the hands of the creatives, engineers, producers and mixers who trust ADAM Audio.

You will own the full lifecycle of one or more assigned studio monitor lines through opportunity framing, pre-development, stage-gate delivery, release and post-launch.
You will monitor, document and analyse customer needs, production workflows, competitor moves and channel dynamics through structured desk research, user interviews, studio visits, dealer feedback, industry research and product testing - turning that into a defensible point of view for the roadmap.
Working in close collaboration with the sales regions during the entire PM process, you will build structured proposals and business cases for new products, refreshes and running changes - including ASP, target BOM, gross margin, volume scenarios and pricing recommendation - for evaluation by Product Leadership and the Exec Team.
You will translate opportunities into concise PRDs with clear acceptance criteria, balancing user value against technical feasibility across acoustics, electronics, firmware, software, and mechanics.
You will partner with R&D, Project Management, JDM/ODM partners, Operations and Marketing, to make trade-offs on features, performance, cost and timing to meet market windows and business objectives.
You will act as the internal hub across ADAM Audio, ensuring coordination and information flow across R&D, Sales, Marketing, Operations and Support throughout development and commercialisation.
You will support go-to-market with pricing strategy, competitive positioning, messaging and go-to-market artefacts (data-sheets, user guides, documentation); track post-launch performance and adjust strategy accordingly.
You will monitor in-market response and quality (warranty rates, returns, support tickets, dealer feedback) and prioritise maintenance releases, firmware updates and running changes based on business and user impact.
You will represent your products at internal and external events - trade conferences, dealer visits, product launches - and act as a credible point of contact for users.
Individual and team development is important, and we will support you as you look for ways to grow and improve your personal knowledge and skills. We will also be looking for you to own and help improve our approach to engineering and design knowledge, including best practices, processes, and tools. There will be the opportunity to share knowledge and practices with all companies across the Focusrite group.

Minimum 5 years of Hardware Product Management experience in professional audio or consumer electronics.
A working command of the loudspeaker stack to be a credible peer to R&D; you can specify a frequency plot and ask the right questions on the measurements.
Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to author a business case, build volume and margin scenarios and reason about unit economics.
Confidence in designing and running listening tests, structured user interviews and studio visits, and translating subjective audio judgement and objective measurement into specific, actionable requirements.
Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken - German language skills are a strong advantage.
Comfort in working autonomously in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and juggling multiple large projects simultaneously.
A genuine passion for music, audio and the creative process, with a feel for what studio professionals actually do with our products.
Willingness to travel up to 20% of the time (trade shows, studio visits, JDM partners in Asia, Focusrite Group regional visits).

A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Physics, Music Technology, Business or a related discipline; MBA or equivalent is a plus.
Direct experience in studio monitors, live sound, hi-fi loudspeakers or other professional acoustic products.
Experience working across regional sales organisations inside a group structure.
Familiarity with Asian culture and etiquette (JDM/ODM partner management).

Neho est l'une des principales sociétés de courtage immobilier en Suisse, redéfinissant le secteur grâce à l'innovation. Nous combinons l'expertise humaine avec des solutions numériques puissantes pour offrir une expérience immobilière plus rapide, plus transparente et plus efficace.

Notre approche a été reconnue par des prix prestigieux, dont le SEF Award 2023. Ce qui nous distingue vraiment, c'est notre modèle à prix fixe, offrant aux clients une alternative moderne aux services traditionnels basés sur la commission, propulsée par une technologie avancée.
**Nous recherchons un ingénieur produit IA pour diriger, de manière pratique, la mise en œuvre de l'IA. Vous construirez les agents qui prennent en charge les parties manuelles et répétitives de l'achat, du financement et de la vente d'une maison, afin que nos experts puissent consacrer leur temps aux moments qui comptent.**
Vous ne partirez pas de zéro. Nous avons une vision convaincante et des prototypes fonctionnels. Votre mission est de faire passer ce modèle du prototype au produit : agents réels, utilisateurs réels, résultats mesurés. Vous mettrez en production un premier agent dans vos premiers mois et développerez un pipeline à partir de là.
**Il s'agit d'un rôle de zéro à un avec une véritable responsabilité et visibilité, relevant directement de notre CTO. Si vous aimez transformer un processus manuel en logiciel fonctionnel livré en semaines plutôt qu'en trimestres, vous vous sentirez chez vous ici.**
**Charge de travail : 80 - 100%**
## **Ingénieur Produit IA** ##
### **Vos tâches** ###
* **Trouver la valeur :** Passez du temps réel avec les chefs de produit, conseillers, agents immobiliers et spécialistes des opérations, cartographiez leurs flux de travail, identifiez les cas d'utilisation des agents qui éliminent le plus de travail mesurable tout au long du parcours client ou des opérations internes - priorisez par résultat
* **Construire les agents, de manière pratique :** Concevez, construisez, testez et déployez les agents vous-même : utilisez des frameworks et plateformes d'agents là où ils sont plus rapides, du code réel là où ils ne le sont pas
* **Assumer la livraison des interfaces :** Faites passer nos prototypes au produit, et faites évoluer la manière dont les agents atteignent les utilisateurs : dans le produit, en chat, puis plus tard sur mobile
* **Construire la couche MCP :** Enveloppez les API stables du domaine dans des outils MCP fins et bien conçus à travers lesquels vos agents agissent. Vous êtes le premier et le plus exigeant consommateur de notre architecture API-first.
* **Conduire les exigences vers les équipes :** Spécifiez les API dont vos agents et interfaces ont besoin auprès des équipes d'ingénierie propriétaires du domaine, qui les construisent et les exposent ; vous consommez des contrats propres plutôt que d'accéder directement aux systèmes
* **Choisir la plateforme avec l'équipe Platform :** Dirigez la sélection de la technologie et des plateformes conjointement avec l'équipe Platform, en tenant compte de la sécurité, de la protection des données suisse/UE, du coût et de l'opérabilité
* **Livrer sur rails, dans les limites :** Déployez sur le chemin cloisonné, containerisé et uniquement API de l'entreprise ; instrumentez et évaluez vos agents ; respectez les niveaux de sensibilité des données
* **Transférer quand un agent grandit :** Quand un agent devient critique pour les revenus ou touche des données client ou financières sensibles, transférez-le à l'ingénierie pour durcissement et prise en charge à long terme, et continuez à construire le suivant
* **Mesurer les résultats :** Suivez l'effort supprimé, le temps de cycle et l'impact sur la conversion, ainsi que l'adoption par les personnes servies par les agents. Pas le nombre d'agents livrés
#### **Ce que ce rôle n'est pas** ####
* **Pas le constructeur des API principales :** Les équipes d'ingénierie du domaine possèdent et exposent les API stables ; vous conduisez les exigences, construisez les fines enveloppes MCP par-dessus, et consommez les contrats
* **Pas le propriétaire de la plateforme/infrastructure :** La plateforme possède l'exécution, le déploiement, l'observabilité et la sécurité ; vous construisez par-dessus
* **Pas un service d'assistance IA :** Vous n'êtes pas là pour construire des outils sur mesure pour chaque département ; vous construisez les agents qui font avancer nos priorités, et aidez les autres à s'auto-servir en toute sécurité sur le chemin autorisé
### **Ce que nous offrons** ###
* Responsabilité complète de votre produit avec l'autorité pour piloter la mise en œuvre, challenger le statu quo, et assumer le résultat de la conception au lancement de nouvelles fonctionnalités
* Une opportunité de carrière unique pour rejoindre une scale-up en forte croissance et primée dans le secteur immobilier
* Façonnez l'avenir de la technologie immobilière en Suisse : Ayez un impact direct sur la croissance de Neho, et livrez des outils IA efficaces et évolutifs qui donnent à Neho un avantage concurrentiel
* Profitez de hiérarchies plates, de processus décisionnels rapides, et de la liberté de travailler de manière autonome et de laisser votre empreinte
* Faites partie d'une équipe dynamique et tournée vers l'avenir, répartie entre nos bureaux de Lausanne et Zurich ainsi que notre équipe d'ingénierie à distance en Roumanie
* Épanouissez-vous dans une culture entrepreneuriale et innovante qui valorise la transparence, l'équité et un fort soutien d'équipe
* Avantages compétitifs incluant 5 semaines de congés + jours supplémentaires selon l'ancienneté, congé maternité/paternité entièrement payé, options de télétravail, événements d'équipe réguliers, et plus encore !
### **Ce que vous apportez** ###
* **Maîtrise de la pile IA :** Vous avez travaillé avec la pile IA moderne sous une forme ou une autre (API directes de modèles, frameworks d'agents comme LangGraph/CrewAI/Google ADK, plateformes d'orchestration comme Dify/n8n). Ce qui compte, c'est ce que vous avez livré, pas l'outil utilisé.
* **Développeur dans l'âme :** Vous avez une formation en ingénierie logicielle et écrivez et gérez du code en production depuis des années. Le langage spécifique importe peu.
* **À l'aise sur toute la pile :** Que ce soit PHP, TypeScript/JavaScript ou Python, vous êtes à l'aise pour construire des applications, des API et d'autres choses comme des extensions de navigateur ou même des applications mobiles.
* **Pragmatique sur les outils :** Vous utilisez les plateformes d'agents et outils IA là où ils sont plus rapides, et écrivez du code réel là où ils ne le sont pas. À l'aise avec MCP, webhooks, prompting et interfaces utilisateur en streaming.
* **Discipliné sur l'évaluation :** Vous avez livré des systèmes basés sur LLM à de vrais utilisateurs : vous écrivez des évaluations, concevez des quadrails, pensez aux modes de défaillance, et savez quand un agent doit refuser de répondre. Data-first operator comfortable with funnels, experimentation, KPIs, and trade-off modelling (conversion vs fraud loss vs ops cost).

Excellent written and verbal communication; highly organised, resourceful, entrepreneurial.
Any experience in the following is a plus: PCI compliance, KYC/KYB workflows

About NAES
At NAES , you’ll find engaging and challenging career opportunities across conventional power generation, renewable energy, energy storage, grid operations and complex industrial facilities. At every level of the company, our people share a common goal: to instill confidence in our clients through a steadfast commitment to safety, integrity, and the quality of our work.
NAES is largest independent operator of power facilities in the industry, managing more than 400 facilities and over 60 GW of generation under contract across the United States, Canada, Mexico and the UK.

Powered by a team of roughly 4,000 people, we now support the full life cycle of energy and industrial plants — from development and construction through operations, optimization, digital transformation and decommissioning — giving our employees the opportunity to grow their careers while helping to modernize the critical infrastructure that keeps communities running.

The Gas Turbine Generator Product Manager is responsible for leading the global strategy, development, and execution of generator products and services. Combine deep technical expertise in generator technology, capability enhancement, restoration, and 50Hz/60Hz conversion with strong leadership in supply chain, service business growth, and operational excellence.

Define and execute global product strategy for generator upgrades, restorations, and frequency conversion solutions.

Conduct market and competitive analysis to position offerings for growth and differentiation.
Technology & Capability Leadership
Lead development of advanced generator technologies, including uprates, efficiency improvements, and reliability enhancements.
Define generator capability limits (thermal, electrical, mechanical) and develop solutions to safely extend performance envelopes.
Collaborate with engineering on innovations in insulation systems, rotor/stator design, cooling technologies, and digital solutions.
Restoration, Life Extension & Conversion Solutions
Develop and standardize restoration programs (rewinds, rotor refurbishments, insulation upgrades) for aging fleets.
Lead lifecycle extension strategies balancing cost, performance, and risk.
Own development and execution of 50Hz ↔ 60Hz conversion solutions, including feasibility, risk assessment, and implementation.
Support diagnostics, failure analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Service Business Development & Growth
Build and scale a high-margin generator service business, including upgrades, field services, and long-term service agreements (LTSAs).
Define service offerings, value propositions, and go-to-market strategies.
Partner with sales to expand installed base penetration and drive aftermarket revenue growth.
Develop standardized service packages and global execution models.
Commercial Leadership
Own commercial strategy, including pricing, margin expansion, and contract structuring.
Develop winning proposals, technical solutions, and business cases (ROI, payback, lifecycle value).
Lead or support customer negotiations with strong technical and financial positioning.
Align product offerings with customer needs and market demand.
Supply Chain Management
Lead supply chain strategy for generator components and services, ensuring cost competitiveness, quality, and delivery reliability.
Develop supplier partnerships, qualification processes, and risk mitigation strategies.
Drive cost reduction through should-cost analysis, design optimization, and sourcing strategies.
Manage risks related to long-lead materials, logistics, and global supply constraints.
Operational Excellence (Quality, Cost, Delivery )
Establish and drive operational performance metrics across product and service lines (quality, cost, delivery, safety).
Ensure high standards of operational quality through robust processes, inspections, and continuous improvement.
Oversee delivery performance, including on-time execution of projects, outages, and field services.
Partner with manufacturing and field operations to improve productivity, reduce cycle times, and eliminate defects.
Implement lessons learned and best practices across global operations.
Cross-Functional Leadership
Serve as the central point of coordination between engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, field service, and commercial teams.
Lead cross-functional initiatives to deliver integrated solutions on time and within budget.
Provide leadership, training, and technical guidance across global teams.
Financial Ownership & Performance Management
Own product line and service P&L, including revenue growth, margin expansion, and cost control.
Track KPIs related to operational performance, customer satisfaction, and financial outcomes.
Drive continuous improvement across technical, commercial, and operational domains.
Working Relationship
The Gas Turbine Generator Product Manager reports to the Director of Product Management / Business Line Leader. Does not have any direct reports.

We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to be the primary product voice for Elastic Security's most strategic enterprise customers. Solid products are built on a clear knowledge of real customer needs. In large enterprise accounts, those needs arrive as a constant stream of enhancement requests, feature asks, and hard problems.

They often arrive faster than any one team can act on them. Someone has to bring order to that stream, tell apart what a customer wants from what a customer needs, and turn it into a coherent product direction across different product areas.
In this high-impact role, you will own the relationship between Elastic Security's product organization and our most strategic enterprise accounts. You will manage enhancement requests across many enterprise customers at once.

You will prioritize them with judgment and data, and make sure they keep transitioning through the system instead of sitting idle.

You will be the person a CISO trusts in the room, the person an engineering lead respects for the quality of your requirements, and the person who can tell a major customer that something will not be built without losing the relationship.

You will work at the intersection of Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Engineering, building the structure that lets Elastic scale close customer relationships without simply adding headcount.
What You Will Be Doing
Own the enhancement request pipeline across multiple strategic enterprise accounts at once. Build and maintain a structured system to track, prioritize, and respond to customer-sourced requirements, and keep requests moving rather than leaving them in “under consideration.”
Translate customer requirements into shipped products. Work at the level of customer pain, not just the feature that was asked for, and synthesize input from many accounts into a single, coherent product direction.
Turn input from strategic accounts into successful products. Look for patterns across accounts. Shape some of these patterns into formal partnerships for design. Make sure the resulting capabilities benefit the wider market, not just the single customer that made the request.
Feed validated customer patterns back into the core product roadmaps, influencing direction well beyond the accounts you cover.
Serve as the primary product voice in meetings with senior customer stakeholders, including the CISO, CTO, and VP of Security Operations. Deliver roadmap updates, including deprioritizations and misses, in a way that keeps the relationship deep.
Prioritize customer-sourced requirements using structured frameworks such as RICE, weighted scoring, and opportunity sizing. Use data where it is available and clear judgment where it is thin, and be transparent about which is which.
Partner with product and engineering leads to write requirements they can act on without follow-up clarification meetings. Understand system architecture well enough to assess feasibility and scope on your own.
Operate across Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Legal. Support deal cycles as a product resource through RFP responses, security questionnaires, and roadmap presentations to prospects.
Navigate tension between a customer's contractual expectations and the internal roadmap , and tackle it directly rather than through routine escalation.
Create artifacts such as roadmap trackers, enhancement request dashboards, and decision memos that give customers and internal stakeholders visibility without requiring a meeting.
Advocate for customer needs inside the company while resisting the pull of the loudest or largest customer setting the roadmap at the expense of the broader market.

Extensive Experience: 7–10 years of product management experience, with at least 4 years in B2B enterprise software. A consistent record of owning a product area with meaningful revenue impact and of leading products from customer input through shipped, iterated outcomes. Direct experience working with named strategic accounts, not only through customer success proxies. Experience with hyperscalers, MSSPs and/or PubSec is a solid plus.
Security Domain Knowledge: Hands-on knowledge with SIEM, SOAR, XDR or broader security operations platforms, either as a product manager or as a practitioner such as a SOC analyst, detection engineer, or security architect.

You can credibly discuss detection engineering, log ingestion pipelines, correlation rules, threat hunting workflows, and compliance use cases without a solutions engineer in the room. You understand the difference between what a CISO wants to hear and what a SOC analyst actually needs.

A background as a security practitioner, such as SOC, incident response, or detection engineering, before moving into product is a solid plus, and brings credibility that is hard to teach.
Enhancement Request Management at Scale: You have personally run a structured enhancement request pipeline across several enterprise accounts at the same time. You can step into a relationship with dozens of open requests and no prior documentation and build a working tracking system within weeks.
Executive Presence: You are comfortable as the primary product voice with C-suite and VP-level customer stakeholders. You can deliver difficult news without losing the relationship, and you can hold both the executive view and the analyst view in the same meeting.
Technical Credibility: You earn respect from engineering through the quality of your requirements rather than through authority. You write specs engineers can act on, and you know enough about architecture to judge feasibility and scope.
Cross-functional Leadership and Influence: You have operated at the intersection of Product, Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Legal, and you know which function owns what and how to advance work across all of them. You lead across a matrixed organization, align multiple stakeholders toward a common vision, and drive execution in a dynamic, remote-first environment, with the autonomy and judgment expected of a principal-level product leader.
Structured Thinking and Bias for Closure: You bring order to unstructured problems, using data to prioritize and clear judgment when data is thin, and staying transparent about which is which. You move work through the system and follow up proactively rather than waiting to be asked, defaulting to visibility through artifacts instead of meetings. You advocate for customer needs while synthesizing them into product direction rather than relaying demands.

About Teramind
Teramind is a global leader in workforce intelligence, insider risk management, and data loss prevention. Used by thousands of companies across 60+ countries, our platform gives organizations the visibility to protect their people, their data, and their operations. We sit at the intersection of three converging markets - Insider Risk, DLP, and Workforce Analytics - and we are one of the few players that spans all three on a unified behavioral data layer.
The Teramind Endpoint Agent is one of the key differentiators of our platform. It runs on hundreds of thousands of endpoints across Windows, macOS, and Linux, capturing the behavioral signal that powers our detection, DLP enforcement, analytics, and AI. The depth and quality of what the Agent sees is a primary reason customers choose Teramind over the alternatives - and the product leader who owns it plays a pivotal role in the company's success.

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the Teramind Endpoint Agent, and the AI Usage Control capabilities built on top of it, end to end.

You will be the single accountable product leader for the roadmap, priorities, and outcomes of the Agent organization - approximately half of Teramind engineering, working across operating systems, low-level platform components, and the server-side telemetry pipeline. This is a pivotal role.

The Agent is one of the strongest competitive moats Teramind has, and the next chapter of the product strategy depends on what we build into it. You are coming in to bring product rigor, customer insight, prioritization discipline, and technical judgment to a team that is capable of shipping world-class endpoint technology.

AI Usage Control is one of the most important things you will build here. Companies have spent twenty years governing what employees do with sensitive data, and they now have a second workforce: AI agents reading files, calling tools, and executing commands on the same machines, with none of the accountability.

Nobody has worked out what supervising them looks like, and much of it never touches the network, so the endpoint is the only place you can see it. You will own that end to end. You will sit alongside other product managers, reporting to the VP of Product. Together, you own Teramind's product surface area.
What You Will Own
The Agent roadmap across all platforms. Windows, macOS, Linux, and the platforms after them. You decide what ships, in what order, and why, balancing customer demand, platform modernization, performance, and security hardening on one prioritized backlog.
The endpoint layer of AI Usage Control . Detecting AI that never touches the network - native desktop clients, IDE-embedded assistants, terminal-based coding agents, AI-native Teramind | Senior Product Manager, AI and Endpoint browsers, and local models running offline - and capturing the prompts, pastes, uploads, and agent-executed commands that browser and network DLP cannot see.
Translating business vision into engineering reality . You turn signals from executives, sales, customers, competitors and the engineering org into a coherent technical roadmap. You are the interpreter between “we need to detect AI exfiltration” and “here is how we instrument the endpoint to see it.”
Building for the enterprise: bulletproof and undetectable . Enterprise customers expect the Agent to be invisible to end users, resilient against tampering, and reliable in conditions that break weaker products. You own the roadmap that keeps it that way.
Performance, footprint, and reliability. Every CPU cycle, megabyte and battery percent we consume is felt by the end user and argued about by the customer's IT team. You set and defend the performance bar.
Define, measure, and meet product KPIs. Adoption, rollout velocity, deployment success rate, crash rates, detection coverage, time-to-patch on OS changes. You set the numbers and hold the team and the company to them.
Industry and ecosystem relationships. Microsoft, Apple, the Linux ecosystem, MDM vendors, and the major AV and EDR vendors. You represent Teramind in technical conversations where the agent's architecture is the subject.

5+ years of product management experience , with at least 3 owning a technical platform, SDK, agent, or systems-level product. This is a senior IC seat: influence without headcount.
Technical depth is non-negotiable . You do not need to write C++, but you should reason about Windows architecture, macOS system extensions, and the trade-offs between Endpoint Security and Network Extension frameworks. You can push back credibly in a design review.
You understand how AI actually runs on a computer . A hosted model in a browser tab, a native desktop client, an IDE-embedded assistant, a CLI coding agent, and a local model under Ollama are five different detection problems, and several are invisible to anything watching the network. You know why, and you know what an audit trail for an autonomous agent has to capture.
Endpoint or systems background. You have shipped endpoint security (EDR, EPP, XDR), monitoring or management agents, OS-level tools, or systems software. CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Defender, Tanium and similar are directly relevant. Pure SaaS and application PMs without systems exposure will struggle here.
You think in outcomes, not features. Success is “95% of customers roll out a new agent version within 30 days,” not “shipped version 27.0.”
You are comfortable with security trade-offs. Visibility versus privacy, tamper protection versus usability, cloud processing versus on-device intelligence. You can hold the attacker's perspective and the IT buyer's perspective in the same conversation.
You work with AI, not just about it. You use AI in your own practice, prototyping to pressure-test concepts before spending engineering cycles, and evaluating model behavior rather than trusting vendor claims.
You bring rigor, and you write. PRDs, decision memos, prioritization frameworks, release cadence, credible engineering-facing specs. In a distributed team, writing is how product management scales.

Engineering background earlier in your career: systems, kernel, driver, or low-level platform work
Windows Filter Drivers, Minifilters or WFP; macOS Endpoint Security or Network Extensions; Linux eBPF, kernel modules or userspace agents
MDM ecosystems (Jamf, Intune, Workspace ONE, Kandji)
Insider risk, DLP, or behavioral analytics
Local model runtimes and on-device inference (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp)
Agentic AI: tool calling, MCP, and autonomous coding or workflow agents
AI governance, AI security, or shadow AI discovery products
EDR and AV co-existence and exclusion lists at scale
Why This Role
Endpoint agents are having a moment. The convergence of insider risk, DLP, AI, and hybrid work is making the endpoint the most strategically important surface in enterprise security and workforce intelligence. Teramind's Agent is one of the deepest data-collection engines in the market - we see things the rest of the category does not - and it is one of the strongest competitive moats we have.

Gametime 's Post-Order UX & AI Automation team owns everything that happens after a fan completes a purchase — setting the right expectations, delivering tickets reliably, communicating proactively when things change, and building the tools our Fan Operations team uses to support customers efficiently.

This PM will own the roadmap for reducing contact rate and cost to serve while raising fan satisfaction, using AI to power both a better self-service experience for fans and better tooling for the internal team who supports them.
This role is open to various levels/ titles — Senior Product Manager, Staff Product Manager, or Principal Product Manager — we're hiring for the right person and scope, not a fixed level.
What You'll Own
Post-order communications: design and streamline the messaging fans receive after purchase — order confirmations, delivery updates, event-change notifications — to set clear expectations and reduce uncertainty
Ticket delivery experience: improve the reliability and clarity of ticket delivery to reduce delivery-related complaints and negative reviews
AI-powered self-service: build fan-facing AI tools (e.g., conversational support, automated resolution flows) that reduce human contact rate for common post-order issues
Agent-assist and internal tooling: build AI-powered tools for our Fan Operations team (e.g., agent-assist, prioritization and routing, automated triage, knowledge retrieval) that reduce handle time and improve resolution quality
CSAT: drive improvements in fan satisfaction across the post-order journey
Cost to serve: lower the cost of supporting each transaction as volume grows, balancing automation with service quality
A roadmap tied directly to contact rate, CSAT, delivery-related complaints, and cost to serve

A track record of shipping product changes that moved measurable business outcomes
Strong cross-functional partnership skills — you'll work closely with Fan Operations leadership, Engineering, Data, Trust & Safety, and Supply
Comfort operating at whatever level you're hired into, from hands-on execution to setting multi-quarter strategy

Experience owning post-purchase experience in a marketplace environment, customer service/support operations, or contact center technology
Experience shipping AI or LLM-powered product features, ideally in a support or self-service context
Familiarity with support metrics (contact rate, handle time, CSAT, cost to serve) and how product changes move them
A data-driven approach — comfort working with SQL/analytics to diagnose where fans get stuck post-purchase

Granicus is seeking a skilled Product Owner to join our engineering team and help build tools that transform how government works. As the Product Owner, you will gather business requirements from cross‑functional stakeholders, shape the product vision, and work closely with engineering to deliver high‑quality, customer‑focused outcomes.
You will define clear acceptance criteria, validate delivery outcomes, and manage a prioritized product backlog. In this role, you are expected to actively leverage AI capabilities to enhance product discovery, refine requirements, accelerate delivery, and improve decision making. This includes using AI to generate insights, analyze patterns, optimize workflows, and drive efficiency across the product lifecycle, while still applying strong product judgment and leadership independent of AI.
You are accountable for delivering roadmap concepts, maintaining product quality, and continuously identifying opportunities to incorporate AI‑driven innovation into both the product experience and internal processes. As a Senior Product Owner, you will balance AI‑enabled acceleration with the foundational skills of product strategy, stakeholder alignment, and disciplined execution.

s.t:

Use AI to accelerate requirements definition, improve acceptance criteria quality, and identify gaps or risks early
​Participate in sprint planning, review, and retrospective meetings and provide feedback to the team
​Ensure acceptance criteria are clearly defined and verify that story implementation matches requirements  ​Drive projects to completion with a focus on efficiency, quality, and continuous improvement enabled by AI insights

Experience using AI‑powered tools to accelerate product discovery, decision making, and execution. Strong exposure to AI‑assisted analysis, pattern detection, and insight generation across the product lifecycle.

Ability to evaluate AI‑driven opportunities, understand model‑enabled behaviors, and incorporate AI‑supported forecasting, prioritization, and scenario modeling into product strategy.

Comfort working with non‑deterministic systems, AI‑enhanced workflows, and emerging AI capabilities that influence customer experience and product quality.At the same time, you bring the foundational product leadership skills needed to operate independently, make sound decisions, and lead teams without relying solely on AI.
Product Strategy & Prioritization
Ability to prioritize product capabilities and features based on vision, customer value, business goals, technical feasibility, and AI‑driven insights
Ability to operate confidently in a fast‑paced environment with shifting priorities
Relentless commitment to prioritization grounded in both human judgment and AI‑supported analysis
AI‑Enhanced Decision Making
Ability to use AI tools to evaluate customer signals, identify patterns, and surface insights that inform product direction
Experience applying AI‑driven forecasting, scenario modeling, and risk analysis
Ability to distinguish when AI adds value and when traditional product instincts should lead
Problem Solving & Analytical Thinking
Strong problem‑solving skills with a detective mindset, using qualitative reasoning and AI‑generated insights to uncover root causes
Ability to break down ambiguous problems using structured thinking supported by AI‑powered analysis
Strong analytical skills and the ability to work independently or lead cross‑functional teams through complex decisions
Leadership & Influence
Ability to influence without authority using data, narrative, and AI‑supported insights
Ability to champion change and guide teams through evolving priorities and new technologies
Ability to build strong working relationships across all levels of the organization
AI‑Enabled Collaboration & Communication
Ability to leverage AI tools to streamline communication, documentation, and alignment across distributed teams
Experience using AI to enhance clarity, storytelling, and cross‑functional understanding
Ability to work effectively with distributed teams across time zones
Product Fundamentals
Ability to flex between technical depth and business context, especially when evaluating AI‑driven features
Passion for customers and delivering high‑quality user experiences, including those enhanced by AI
Strong understanding of product development processes, tradeoffs, and lifecycle management

3+ years working with technical teams, product development, or product management
Experience working with AI‑enabled workflows or AI‑driven product capabilities is a strong plus
Experience with SaaS or web‑based products and modern product delivery practices

The transport revolution is on the horizon, presenting significant challenges and opportunities in the mobility sector.
We're focused on delivering the right charge points at the right time and place. As the UK's leading public EV charging provider, ubitricity collaborates with local authorities to install and operate charging solutions for electric vehicles in public spaces.
To rapidly expand the charging infrastructure, we operate lamppost, AC fast, and DC rapid charge points across Germany, the UK, France and the Netherlands. As a Product Manager in our Ecosystem team, you'll help advance e-mobility and build an efficient, accessible charging network for everyone.

Put the EV driver at the center of everything we build. You'll own and evolve the ecosystem services and integrations — connecting our teams, markets and suppliers — that make charging effortless and reliable for every driver, from the moment they plug in to the moment they pay, while keeping operations running smoothly, priorities aligned, and a complex software environment continuously improving.

Own the budget for development and design initiatives in your area.
Shapen and coordinate API and system integrations across internal teams and external suppliers and stakeholders, and facilitate alignment between Software, Hardware, Operations, Commercial and partners, ensuring a seamless experience for drivers.
Take ownership of product quality in your area, continuously improving how work is planned, shipped and maintained.
Proactively identify customer pain points, operational challenges and market opportunities, and translate them into product improvements and new initiatives.
Prioritise work using value-based frameworks, considering customer impact, business value and strategic goals, in a multi-stakeholder environment.
Translate customers’, business and technical needs into clear requirements and user stories.
Support iterative delivery and small pilots, and equip local markets with the tooling, documentation and support they need to move fast.
Work closely with engineers day to day to clarify scope, answer questions and make implementation trade-offs.
Run Scrum processes for the development team and coordinate work packages with internal colleagues.
Prototype new feature UI/UX directly in our live application using AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot to validate ideas before engineering builds them.

3+ years as a Technical Product Manager or similar, working on platforms, APIs, integrations or internal tools — ideally in the EV industry, energy, IoT or hardware-software ecosystems.
Technically comfortable, well beyond spreadsheet tools — able to work with APIs, dashboards and low-/no-code platforms without needing to write production code.
Comfortable using AI tools such as GitHub Copilot in daily work
Strong stakeholder management, clear, structured communicator who can bridge engineering, operations, commercial teams, partners and customers.
Data-driven problem solver with strong analytical thinking and UX focus for internal Stakeholder and external customers.
Demonstrated ability to proactively identify opportunities, define solutions and drive initiatives from concept through delivery
Comfortable operating in complex, multi-stakeholder service environments.
Collaborative, pragmatic and adaptable in a small, fast-evolving organization.
English C1 required; German is a plus.
Our Offer
Real impact: products that move the sustainable mobility transition forward, at a company with a well-established and uniquely placed position in the sector.
Real ownership: short decision paths, fast execution, and room to define, evaluate and improve systems and processes across the business.
Close collaboration with teams in Berlin, London and Amsterdam, inside an agile company backed by a leading global energy company.

A team that genuinely loves what it does.

About Arize
AI is rapidly transforming the world. As generative AI reshapes industries, teams need powerful ways to monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize their AI systems. That’s where we come in. Arize AI is the leading AI & Agent Engineering observability and evaluation platform , empowering AI engineers to ship high-performing, reliable agents and applications. From first prototype to production scale, Arize AX unifies build, test, and run in a single workspace—so teams can ship faster with confidence.
We’re a Series C company backed by top-tier investors,with over $135M in funding and a rapidly growing customer base of 150+ leading enterprises and Fortune 500 companies. Customers like , Uber, Siemens, and PepsiCo leverage Arize to deliver AI that works.
The Opportunity
AI is rapidly transforming the world. Whether it’s developing the next generation of human-level intelligence, enhancing voice assistants, or enabling researchers to analyze genetic markers at scale, AI is increasingly integrated into various aspects of our daily lives.
Arize AI is the leading AI observability and evaluation platform, empowering AI engineers to build and deploy high-performing, reliable models. As the AI landscape shifts from traditional ML to generative AI and agentic systems, Arize ensures teams have the tools to monitor, troubleshoot, and improve AI in production.

Our team is working to define the “canonical stack” for AI workflows, by solving the toughest problems in AI today: how to experiment, evaluate, understand and improve models or applications at scale in a responsible way.

The product team has deep technical and strategic backgrounds from leading AI/ML companies (Uber, Cruise, Spotify, Apple) and experience shipping market leading platforms at scale.

Working with this team is an opportunity to develop further as a PM leader in a rapidly growing space by collaborating with some of the best in class AI Engineers and Data Scientists in the industry.

You will be owning, strategizing, and developing a large portion of Arize AI ’s core product roadmap.
From ideation to creation, you will be involved in all stages of the product life cycle.
You will be engaging with our customers directly to gather meaningful insight and feedback in order to create a world class product.
You will be working cross functionally with internal and external stakeholders; including engineering, design, marketing, and sales to drive our product strategy into production.
You will be responsible for communicating and integrating competitive analysis, usability research, and market analysis into product requirements.
Utilize your understanding in AI/ML/CV or related technical space in order to contribute to Arize AI ’s main product offering.

3-5+ years of relevant product management experience or previous AI/ML experience with strong product ownership in an AI-native company
Previous engineering and/or tech lead experience
Strong track record of building in a technical domain while shipping quickly and efficiently.
Willingness to get your hands dirty with code!
Experience and/or knowledge of working within machine learning, or data platforms and infrastructure.
Experience working directly with customers and promoting community discussions in order to gather client feedback.
Experience driving data-informed product strategy into production.

Experience in API design
Early startup experience
Experience working with Figma or similar design tools
The estimated annual salary for this role is between $200,000-$250,000, plus a competitive equity package. Actual compensation is determined based upon a variety of job related factors that may include: transferable work experience, skill sets, and qualifications. Total compensation also includes a comprehensive benefit package, including: medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, unlimited paid time off, generous parental leave plan, and others for mental and wellness support.
While we are a remote-first company, we have opened offices in New York City and the San Francisco Bay Area, as an option for those in those cities who wish to work in-person. For all other employees, there is a WFH monthly stipend to pay for co-working spaces.
More About Arize
Arize’s mission is to make the world’s AI work—and work for people.
Our founders came together through a shared frustration: while investments in AI are growing rapidly across every industry, organizations face a critical challenge—understanding whether AI is performing and how to improve it at scale.

Conducting in-depth analysis of HR business needs, gathering and accurately defining functional and non-functional requirements, and translating them into clear, detailed requirement artifacts. Using key metrics to inform decision-making and make data-driven adjustments that align with business objectives and improve overall outcomes.

Reporting to our Director of People Strategy & Insights and collaborating closely with People Partners, Leaders, FP&A, IT, and AI and Platform Engineering, you'll translate complex People domain challenges into elegant, scalable products that make a real difference in how we operate. At Taxfix, we're building an AI-native company — and this role sits right at the heart of that mission.

Develop a deep understanding of the employee as “Builder” concept, and map the requirements different parts of the organisation have to unlock the capability of Engineers and non-Engineers to ship agentic workflows.
Design and implement AI-augmented tools and human-AI collaboration patterns, experimenting with emerging techniques to push the boundaries of what's possible in People operations.
Build, iterate, and continuously improve People applications using no-code and low-code platforms such as Claude Code, Notion, n8n, Google Cloud Apps, and other AI tools — owning the full product lifecycle from concept through delivery and optimisation.
Lead the continued adaption of Product mindset and ways of working across the People function, including the development and on going refinement of the People Products Roadmap.
Translate stakeholder needs into a prioritised People applications roadmap, balancing day-to-day operational demands with longer-term strategic initiatives and a clear build-vs-buy framework.
Build and maintain integrations across the People tech stack — including HiBob, Ashby, Peakon, and Postgres — ensuring seamless data flows, strong data integrity, and reliable automation via n8n.
Lead change management for new applications and features, creating documentation, training materials, and enablement sessions, then gathering feedback to iterate rapidly.
Partner with PSI leadership, People Partners, Workforce Planners, and FP&A, while collaborating with IT and Engineering to ensure all solutions meet IT security and privacy standards.
Your profile
You bring 5+ years of experience in technical product management or a closely related role, with a proven track record of building and shipping internal tools end-to-end.
You have hands-on experience building with AI tools such as Claude, GPT, or Google AI Studio, and you think naturally about how to design effective human-AI collaboration patterns.
You are a curious PM that is not afraid to challenge the status quo in a pragmatic and constructive way.
You are thinking in systems, understanding the economical aspect of internal processes and products and how those can create value.
You are technically fluent, comfortable working with APIs, webhooks, SQL, and cross-system data flows, and you know when to bring in Engineering versus when to build it yourself.
You have a product mindset: you manage roadmaps, prioritise ruthlessly, and deliver incremental value in fast-paced environments, all while keeping the end user's experience front and centre.
You are highly proficient with no-code and low-code platforms, Notion, n8n, AppSheet, Google Cloud Apps, or similar, and you're comfortable designing data models that support complex business logic and reporting.
Experience in People or HR tech, workforce planning, or org design is a strong plus, as is a background in high-growth startup or scale-up environments where ambiguity is the norm, not the exception.

Job Title: Staff/Principal Product Manager, Patient Experience
Location: Remote, USA

Wheel is evolving the traditional care ecosystem by equipping the nation's most innovative companies with a premier platform to deliver high-quality virtual care at scale. We offer proven strategies and cutting-edge technologies to foster consumer engagement, build brand loyalty, and maximize return on investment.

Wheel solutions include configurable virtual care programs, an intuitive consumer interface, and access to a nationwide network of board-certified clinicians. Discover how Wheel is transforming the future of healthcare by visiting www.wheel.com .

As a Staff/Principal Product Manager, Patient Experience at Wheel, you will own the strategy and roadmap behind the consumer-facing experience that patients use to access care through our enterprise partners. This is a B2B2C role: our patients interact with Wheel through partner brands, so you'll need to design experiences that satisfy a consumer's expectations for a modern healthcare product while also meeting the technical, brand, and compliance requirements of large enterprise partners.
You'll operate at a systems level, connecting patient-facing experience decisions to the underlying clinical, operational, and platform architecture that makes those experiences possible. You bring real hands-on experience shaping AI-powered product, not just using AI tools in your own workflow. This is a builder role for a senior product leader who can set a multi-year vision for patient experience and drive it forward through close, hands-on partnership with Engineering.

Strategy & Vision
Define the multi-year vision and roadmap for the patient experience across Wheel's white-labeled consumer surfaces, balancing partner-specific requirements with a coherent, scalable core product
Establish a point of view on where the patient experience should be standardized across partners versus configured per partner, and build the frameworks to support that decision-making
Translate enterprise partner requirements across market segments into a unified product strategy that serves patients well regardless of the front door they came through
Champion design as a strategic differentiator; work hand-in-hand with Design to set a bar for what a trustworthy, AI+human powered patient experience looks like at scale
Systems Thinking & Cross-Functional Execution
Map the patient journey end to end, from first touchpoint through clinical encounter to follow-up, and identify where friction, drop-off, or trust gaps occur
Partner closely with Engineering, Clinical Operations, and partner-facing teams to design solutions that hold up across a distributed network of clinicians and multiple partner integrations
Define the product requirements, success metrics, and evaluation criteria for AI-driven capabilities within the patient experience (for example, intake, triage support, or personalization), including partnering on model and product tradeoffs and on iteration post-launch based on real usage data
Break down ambiguous, cross-functional problems into clear requirements and plans, and drive alignment with Engineering from concept through launch and iteration
Cross-Functional Leadership
Act as a primary product voice in conversations with Account Management and their enterprise partners about patient experience, translating patient experience strategy into terms that resonate with partner stakeholders
Communicate vision, tradeoffs, and progress clearly to executive leadership, engineering teams, and non-technical partner stakeholders alike
Mentor and influence other product managers on systems thinking and product craft in partnership with their managers

8+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning consumer-facing products at a senior or lead level (Staff, Principal or equivalent scope). Leveling will be based on demonstrated scope of impact in the interview process
